Despite being at the end of a grueling four-day trip to France, Leo noted a news report Monday afternoon about [Nvidia introducing guardrails](https://apnews.com/article/nvidia-ai-agent-artificial-intelligence-safety-3c4d7c1cfde82851c0577d1fa29b8621) into AI.

item.description:
WASHINGTON — After privately huddling with nearly 20 tech titans at a White House lunch Tuesday, [President Donald Trump](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump) continued to push back on calls for new safety regulations for [artificial intelligence](https://www.nbcnews.com/artificial-intelligence), saying there was agreement in the room that there should be “tremendous self-regulation” by companies.
The day’s events included Trump saying he would sign an executive order renaming artificial intelligence as “super intelligence.”

item.title: China 'respects' Trump's decision to refer to artificial intelligence as 'super intelligence'
item.description:
## AG Blanche rejects calls for new AI laws after rogue agents target US government websites Attorney General Todd Blanche rejected calls for additional artificial intelligence regulation Sunday on "Fox & Friends Weekend," arguing that existing laws already give the government the tools it needs to pursue bad actors after reports allege that rogue AI agents targeted [U.S. government websites](https://www.foxnews.com/politics).
## Trump defends AI growth amid concerns over advanced systems: 'I don't worry about it' When asked by Fox News' White House correspondent Aishah Hasnie about reports detailing thousands of problematic [AI incidents](https://www.foxbusiness.com/category/artificial-intelligence) involving Anthropic and OpenAI, Trump said he was not concerned.

Getty Images

Throughout the week, Trump has repeatedly said he feels "super intelligence" is a more accurate term because the adjective "artificial" makes AI sound "fake."
